name: AI Toolz

sources.title: SaaSHub profile — describes Aitoolz.net as an 8,000+ tool AI directory; 'you can signup and share your own AI tools and Prompts for free'
Homepage — returned HTTP 403 to the fetcher on every path tried; not directly readable

requirements: Product should be an AI tool or AI-related resource — directory is AI-only
Free submission path: sign up for an account, then share your own AI tools and prompts (per SaaSHub listing)
Site supports upvotes, favorites, and user-curated public collections
preparation: Product name, URL, and a short description
Category selection (image generation, text, coding assistants, productivity, etc.)
Optional: prompts/copy-prompt text if listing a prompt-based tool
An email address for account signup
workflow: Open https://aitoolz.net/ and register an account (signup is free)
Use the site's share/submit flow to add the AI tool with name, URL, description, and category
Listing becomes eligible for community upvotes, favorites, and inclusion in user collections
watchFor: The site 403s automated fetches (Cloudflare-style block) — submission likely requires an interactive browser session
aitoolz.net is distinct from aitoolzdir.com and aitoolz.ai, which are separate paid-submit directories — do not confuse them
Low-DR community directory; value is a listing page, not meaningful traffic
countsAsLive: The tool has a public detail page on aitoolz.net reachable while logged out, appearing in its category listing
unknowns: Exact submission URL and form fields — the site blocked all direct fetches
Whether account creation requires email verification or social login
